title: Self-Help Maintenance Provision of Community Rules & Site Care
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care the community may, in defined cases, cure a violation on a home site itself.

## Provision

1. The community may cure a violation itself only for a rule class listed among the plan's self-help rule classes, and only when the item is the resident's responsibility under the plan in force.
2. Self-help may be performed only after the cure deadline has passed, counted from the violation notice date. The cure period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the notice date; the deadline day itself still belongs to the resident, and self-help may be performed from the following day. The notice date and the cure deadline are read from the notice in the system's records.
3. The former sentence "the charge is the contractor's invoice plus the plan's administration fee, rounded half up to the cent, posted on the date of the work and referenced to the notice" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for self-help charges.
4. A notice withdrawn as the community's responsibility, or cured by the resident on or before the deadline, is never charged.

## When self-help is permitted

| Rule class among the self-help classes | Item is the resident's responsibility under the plan in force | Cure deadline has passed | Self-help |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | may be performed |
| no | any | any | may not be performed |
| any | no | any | may not be performed |
| any | any | no | may not be performed |

## Boundary cases

| Hypothetical notice | Counting starts | Cure deadline (still the resident's) | Earliest day for self-help |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lawn and landscaping notice dated 4 May, 7-day period | 5 May | 11 May | 12 May |
| Snow and ice notice dated 9 January, 1-day period | 10 January | 10 January | 11 January |

Self-help on the deadline day itself — 11 May in the first case — is not permitted.

superseded_clauses: The charge is the contractor's invoice (self_help_cost_basis) plus the plan's self_help_admin_fee, rounded half up to the cent, posted on the date of the work and referenced to the notice.
